description: This file implements a Plivo voice call provider with methods for initiating, managing, and handling webhooks for calls, including TTS and speech recognition features.

classes.name: PlivoProvider
classes.description: A class implementing the VoiceCallProvider interface for Plivo, handling call setup, webhooks, and call control.

methods.name: verifyWebhook
methods.description: Verifies incoming webhook requests from Plivo using provided security options.

methods.name: parseWebhookEvent
methods.description: Parses incoming webhook payloads to generate normalized call events.

methods.name: initiateCall
methods.description: Starts a new outbound call via Plivo API.

methods.name: playTts
methods.description: Transfers call leg to play text-to-speech.

methods.name: startListening
methods.description: Transfers call leg to start speech recognition.

methods.name: stopListening
methods.description: Ends speech recognition (no implementation, handled automatically).

methods.name: getCallStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status of a call.
